events.description:
The case's activity (S2-29): created first, then each stage run's start and end and each
submission, oldest first. No values: only what, which stage or task, who and when.
events.title: Events

fields.description: Start-form values, without fields hidden from the user's level.
fields.title: Fields

release_version.description: The release the case started on, which its start values were captured on.
release_version.title: Release Version

sections.description:
The start form of the newer of the active release and the case's own, as the user sees
it, filled with the case's values; a removed field shows while the case has a value for it.
A value whose field that form no longer places comes last, in the section `_other`.
sections.title: Sections

title.description: The case's first text start field (e.g. the site's name), else its code.
title.title: Title

flow.description: Key of one of the workflow's flows.
flow.title: Flow

values.description: The flow's start form, field key → value.
values.title: Values

code.description: e.g. `MX-0001`; also the Operaton business key.
code.title: Code

fields.description: Start-form values, without fields hidden from the user's level.
fields.title: Fields

release_version.description: The release the case started on, which its start values were captured on.
release_version.title: Release Version

title.description: The case's first text start field (e.g. the site's name), else its code.
title.title: Title

after_sha256.description: The sha256 of the draft it left, over jsonb's text form.
after_sha256.title: After Sha256

patch.description: The RFC 6902 operations applied to the draft.
patch.title: Patch

tool.description: What made the change: an agent tool's name, `set_theme` or `undo`.
tool.title: Tool

undoes.description: On an undo's row, the change it undid.
undoes.title: Undoes

ChangeRequestOut.description:
A stored request as stored: a payload sent under older rules still reads, so one old row
can't fail the list.

shipped_in_version.description: The release that carries it, once shipped.
shipped_in_version.title: Shipped In Version

ChangeRequestOut.title: ChangeRequestOut

mode.description: `configure` sets a client up (effort high); `edit` changes it later (effort medium).
mode.title: Mode

key.description: Department key; Operaton candidate groups are derived as `<key>__L<n>`.
key.title: Key

DraftDiff.description: What publishing the draft would change; every list empty and both looks null = nothing.

blocks.description: Keys of pages whose blocks changed, added and removed pages included.
blocks.title: Blocks

stages.description: By `<flow>.<stage>`: its name, department, `after` and the order of its tasks.

tasks.description: By task id, across every flow; moving a task to another stage changes it.

DraftDiff.title: DraftDiff

base_version.description: The release this draft was published as; null until publish records it.
base_version.title: Base Version

by.description: Who started the case or submitted the task.
by.title: By

kind.description: `stage_closed`: the case was closed in the stage, or the close cut it short.
kind.title: Kind

path.description:
JSON Pointer to the field, e.g. `/ca_amount`; a draft's are `workflow.json` paths, e.g.
`flows[0].stages[1].after[0]`.
path.title: Path

label.description: The label in the release the sections follow: a renamed field shows its new one.
label.title: Label

since.description:
Set when the case's release didn't have the field: the release that added it (no value;
the shell shows "added in vN").
since.title: Since

schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for the submission, without sections hidden from this user.
schema.title: Schema

options.description: The choices of a `select` or `multi_select` field, and only of those.
options.title: Options

can_act.description: The user may submit it (else they see it as their department's lead).
can_act.title: Can Act

Preferences.description:
A user's appearance (#93, D19): only colours; null = no choice yet (scheme: auto, accent:
the client's, then the preset's). The shell skips accents it doesn't know, so the accent list
lives only there.
Preferences.title: Preferences

PreferencesIn.description: The body of `PUT /app/me/preferences`: any other key is a 422, not silently dropped.
PreferencesIn.title: PreferencesIn

Problem.description: Problem details (RFC 9457), the body of every error response.

errors.description: One entry per invalid field (422, or a 409 on a taken value); otherwise null.
errors.title: Errors

Problem.title: Problem

created.description: False when nothing changed since the last publish (no new version).
created.title: Created

label.description: The new label; the stored key stays.
label.title: Label

state.description: `closed`: the case was closed in this stage, or the close cancelled it while it ran.
state.title: State

outcome.description: One of the task's outcome ids, when it has outcomes.
outcome.title: Outcome

status.description: `committed` normally; `pending`/`completed` while a repeated request's first is running.
status.title: Status

editable.description: False when the user may only read the task (level 2+ in its department).
editable.title: Editable

show.description: Read-only values from earlier steps, by field key.
show.title: Show

show_labels.description: The label of each field `show` may hold, from the release.
show_labels.title: Show Labels

stage.description: Key of the stage the task belongs to.
stage.title: Stage

accent.description: The client's default accent; null = the preset's own.
accent.title: Accent

theme.description: Theme preset key (D19), checked as the draft's `apps.theme`.
theme.title: Theme

get.description: The client's requests, newest first, `limit` at a time; fewer than `limit` is the end.

schema.title: Response List Change Requests App Admin Change Requests Get

post.description:
With an `Idempotency-Key`, sending the same request again returns the first one instead
of storing it twice.

get.description: What a request may name: the active release's forms with their fields, and field types.
Another client's request is a 404, like one that doesn't exist.
What memberships may name: the active release's departments and levels.

schema.title: Response List Departments App Admin Departments Get
Response List Users App Admin Users Get

patch.description:
New memberships and/or status, then the Operaton mirror. If Operaton fails (502) the change
is kept, and the reconciler finishes the mirror (`users.resync`), as does sending it again.

get.description: Every case of the client (newest first, up to 500) with its stage states.

schema.title: Response List Cases App Cases Get

post.description: Start a case of one of the workflow's flows, with its start form's values.

get.description: One case: its stages with times, values by section, open tasks, decisions and activity.
The signed-in user and memberships, read on every call so level changes apply at once.

put.description: Saves only the keys sent; the shell applies them after every sign-in, on any device.

get.description:
`mine`: the user's tasks and their groups' unclaimed ones. `team` (level 2+): every task
of their departments. `flow` and `case` (a case code) narrow the list.

schema.title: Response List Tasks App Tasks Get

get.description: One task with its case, its form as this user sees it, and the values it shows.

post.description:
Submit a task. Send a fresh `Idempotency-Key` per submission; repeating a key returns the
first result instead of submitting again.

get.description: The active release's nav, pages and flows, filtered to the user's departments.

post.description:
An invited person (S2-23) sets their password and is signed in. The token
(`<slug>.<random>`, `zm_api.people`) works once, for 7 days. The Operaton mirror runs inside
the transaction, so if it fails the invite still works.
The client behind a workspace code, so the sign-in screen can show its name and look.

schema.title: Response List Clients Owner Clients Get

post.description: The client and its provisioning steps, in one transaction; the worker takes it from here.

get.description: The client with its provisioning steps and releases (the console polls this).

post.description: A new conversation with the client's agent.

One turn, streamed: `text_delta {text}`, `retry {}` (drop the text this call streamed so
far), `tool_call {name}`, `change {change_id, summary}`, `refusal {category}` and
`error {message}` events, then `done {usage}`.
The client's admin, invited by email (they manage people, never the flow, forms or UI).

schema.title: Response List Changes Owner Clients  Client Id  Draft Changes Get

get.description: The draft against the active release (everything is added before the first publish).

patch.description: The client's theme preset and default accent (D19); only the keys sent change.

post.description:
Undo the newest change not yet undone; 409 when there is none or it can't be undone (the
draft was written outside the log since, or a published field would be deleted or retyped).

get.description: Every problem in the draft; empty when it is valid.

schema.title: Response Get Validation Owner Clients  Client Id  Draft Validate Get

post.description:
Re-queue the first failed (or `needs_human`) step only; every other step is left alone.

Should the worker carry on past a stuck step, a later stuck one waits for the next retry.
Publish the client's draft as its next release (a person clicks Publish, never the agent).

get.description: Starter templates for a new client (`zm-api templates sync` fills them).

schema.title: Response List Templates Owner Templates Get
